jobs.title: Director of Engineering (Utility-Scale Solar & BESS)
jobs.description:
This role is based in Arlington, VA. On-site presence is required.

About the Company

Join a leading independent power producer at the forefront of renewable energy development. With a growing portfolio of utility-scale solar projects across Virginia, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, and Kentucky, our client develops, constructs, owns, and operates renewable energy assets backed by a 7GW+ global pipeline and over 1GW already commissioned.

The Role

We are hiring a Director of Engineering who will be based at the Arlington, Virginia headquarters. This role leads and manages an engineering team supporting projects involving utility-scale solar facilities, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and related generation tie lines and substations. It oversees engineering design activities, coordination with third-party consultants and contractors, and the delivery of technical support throughout project development, procurement, construction, and commissioning.

The engineering group manages civil and electrical design scopes, conducts design reviews to enhance system performance and reduce costs, and develops standardized, repeatable design solutions for future projects. The Director also provides technical leadership to internal teams including Development, M&A;, Construction, Operations Engineering, Compliance, and Asset Management, while establishing team objectives, workflows, and operating procedures.

Key Responsibilities

Lead a multidisciplinary team of civil and electrical engineers and technical specialists
Continuously improve engineering design management processes
Forecast staffing needs based on active projects and future pipeline, and assign resources to support development and construction activities
Identify long-term resource requirements and recruit project engineering personnel
Act as a senior technical authority supporting development, M&A, and construction efforts, and manage external subject-matter experts as required
Review and resolve complex technical issues in collaboration with internal experts and external consultants
Develop and implement efficient engineering workflows focused on standardization and repeatable designs
Provide technical coordination with Operations Engineering, Development, Compliance, and Asset Management teams at various project stages
Ensure regulatory and compliance requirements, including NERC standards, are incorporated into project designs
Lead technical coordination with lenders' independent engineers during design and construction phases
Periodic site visits as required

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in engineering required; electrical engineering preferred
Professional Engineering License
8 years + of experience in the energy industry
Minimum of 5 years of experience in utility-scale solar project engineering; BESS experience is a plus
Experience working in PJM and MISO markets is a plus
Background in civil and electrical design, medium-voltage collection systems, high-voltage substations, and SCADA for utility-scale solar projects
Experience supporting construction and commissioning activities
Experience preparing or reviewing construction cost estimates for similar projects

Work Location, Remote Work, and Travel

This position will be based in Arlington, VA. Travel may be required over time.

jobs.description:

CEO

About TheLinkU

TheLinkU is a fast-growing NIL SaaS platform connecting student athletes, universities, brands, and fans. Our platform, LinkSuite, supports the NIL ecosystem including revenue share contract execution, cap management, athlete payment processing, brand opportunities, membership programs, and community engagement. We are live with well-known universities, with real athletes and real contracts being managed on the platform every day.
We are a lean, fast-moving team where leaders have real ownership and the ability to make an immediate impact.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on CTO to lead TheLinkU's engineering function through its next stage of growth. This is not a figurehead or pure strategy role. The CTO will be directly involved in architecture, technical decisions, engineering standards, troubleshooting, and delivery while empowering the engineering team to own day-to-day implementation.
You will work closely with the CEO and Director of Product to turn business priorities into a practical product and technical roadmap. You will inherit an established production platform and a lean offshore engineering team, with additional engineering capacity planned as the company grows.
The incoming CTO will have a structured transition with the current technology leadership covering the platform, architecture, infrastructure, integrations, engineering team, roadmap, and operational processes.
Current Environment: LinkSuite is an established production SaaS platform built primarily on PHP/Laravel and AWS

What You Will Own

·      Lead, mentor, and grow the engineering team while setting clear standards for quality, accountability, delivery, and technical culture.
·      Stay closely engaged with day-to-day engineering execution, including developer discussions, technical blockers, architecture and code decisions, delivery progress, and production issues.
·      Own LinkSuite's technical architecture and engineering standards, including scalability, AWS infrastructure, security, reliability, technical debt, code quality, and deployment practices.
·      Manage and develop our offshore engineering team effectively, maintaining strong communication, velocity, quality, and alignment across time zones.
·      Partner closely with the Director of Product to translate business requirements into technically sound solutions and maintain a practical product and engineering roadmap.
·      Champion effective Agile and Scrum practices, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint ceremonies, retrospectives, and consistent delivery of shippable software.
·      Own engineering delivery and platform operations, including release quality, monitoring, uptime, incident response, and continuous improvement.
·      Own the company's technical security posture and ensure the platform can meet the security and technology expectations of university and enterprise partners.
·      Guide the technical strategy for payments, financial workflows, APIs, third-party integrations, and technology vendors, including build-versus-buy decisions.
·      Work with the CEO on the 1-to-3-year technical vision and the engineering resources, architecture, and investments needed to support company growth.
·      Evaluate relevant opportunities in AI, automation, integrations, and emerging technologies that can improve the product or internal operations.
·      Represent TheLinkU credibly in customer, university, partner, and vendor conversations when technical leadership is needed.

What We Are Looking For & Must Haves

·      10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 5 years in senior engineering or technology leadership.
·      Proven experience owning and evolving the architecture of a production SaaS platform with real customers.
·      Strong technical depth and the ability to work credibly with engineers on architecture, code quality, system design, reliability, and technical trade-offs.
·      Experience leading remote or offshore engineering teams and growing engineering organizations.
·      Experience with cloud-based SaaS infrastructure, preferably AWS, including deployment, security, monitoring, and scalability.
·      Experience with payments, financial transactions, sensitive data, or other high-reliability production workflows.
·      Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical executives, product leaders, customers, and partners.
·      Comfort operating in a lean, fast-moving environment where leaders are expected to be both strategic and hands-on.

Additional Nice To Haves

·      Experience as a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar technology leader in a growth-stage SaaS company.
·      Experience with marketplace, community, payments, contract management, or compliance-sensitive platforms.
·      Familiarity with sports, college athletics, NIL, fintech, or adjacent industries.
·      Experience applying AI and automation to product or operational workflows.

The Environment You Will Be Joining

TheLinkU operates with a lean leadership structure and a small, capable offshore engineering team rather than multiple layers of engineering management, a dedicated DevOps organization, or a PMO. This gives the CTO genuine ownership of technical decisions, direct access to company leadership, and the opportunity to shape how the engineering organization evolves as the platform and customer base grow.

Why Join TheLinkU

·      Real ownership: you will be the technical decision-maker and a key member of the leadership team.
·      A live and growing product: LinkSuite is already supporting real university partners, athletes, contracts, and payments.
·      A meaningful market: NIL is changing how college athletes build their careers and financial futures.
·      A fast-moving leadership team where decisions are made quickly and leaders are trusted to execute.
We are setting the standard for the industry, come be a part of something special!!!

About TheLinkU

TheLinkU is a fast-growing NIL SaaS platform connecting student athletes, universities, brands, and fans. Our platform, LinkSuite, supports the NIL ecosystem including revenue share contract execution, cap management, athlete payment processing, brand opportunities, membership programs, and community engagement. We are live with well-known universities, with real athletes and real contracts being managed on the platform every day.
We are a lean, fast-moving team where leaders have real ownership and the ability to make an immediate impact.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on CTO to lead TheLinkU's engineering function through its next stage of growth. This is not a figurehead or pure strategy role. The CTO will be directly involved in architecture, technical decisions, engineering standards, troubleshooting, and delivery while empowering the engineering team to own day-to-day implementation.
You will work closely with the CEO and Director of Product to turn business priorities into a practical product and technical roadmap. You will inherit an established production platform and a lean offshore engineering team, with additional engineering capacity planned as the company grows.
The incoming CTO will have a structured transition with the current technology leadership covering the platform, architecture, infrastructure, integrations, engineering team, roadmap, and operational processes.
Current Environment: LinkSuite is an established production SaaS platform built primarily on PHP/Laravel and AWS

What You Will Own

·      Lead, mentor, and grow the engineering team while setting clear standards for quality, accountability, delivery, and technical culture.
·      Stay closely engaged with day-to-day engineering execution, including developer discussions, technical blockers, architecture and code decisions, delivery progress, and production issues.
·      Own LinkSuite's technical architecture and engineering standards, including scalability, AWS infrastructure, security, reliability, technical debt, code quality, and deployment practices.
·      Manage and develop our offshore engineering team effectively, maintaining strong communication, velocity, quality, and alignment across time zones.
·      Partner closely with the Director of Product to translate business requirements into technically sound solutions and maintain a practical product and engineering roadmap.
·      Champion effective Agile and Scrum practices, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint ceremonies, retrospectives, and consistent delivery of shippable software.
·      Own engineering delivery and platform operations, including release quality, monitoring, uptime, incident response, and continuous improvement.
·      Own the company's technical security posture and ensure the platform can meet the security and technology expectations of university and enterprise partners.
·      Guide the technical strategy for payments, financial workflows, APIs, third-party integrations, and technology vendors, including build-versus-buy decisions.
·      Work with the CEO on the 1-to-3-year technical vision and the engineering resources, architecture, and investments needed to support company growth.
·      Evaluate relevant opportunities in AI, automation, integrations, and emerging technologies that can improve the product or internal operations.
·      Represent TheLinkU credibly in customer, university, partner, and vendor conversations when technical leadership is needed.

What We Are Looking For & Must Haves

·      10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 5 years in senior engineering or technology leadership.
·      Proven experience owning and evolving the architecture of a production SaaS platform with real customers.
·      Strong technical depth and the ability to work credibly with engineers on architecture, code quality, system design, reliability, and technical trade-offs.
·      Experience leading remote or offshore engineering teams and growing engineering organizations.
·      Experience with cloud-based SaaS infrastructure, preferably AWS, including deployment, security, monitoring, and scalability.
·      Experience with payments, financial transactions, sensitive data, or other high-reliability production workflows.
·      Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical executives, product leaders, customers, and partners.
·      Comfort operating in a lean, fast-moving environment where leaders are expected to be both strategic and hands-on.

Additional Nice To Haves

·      Experience as a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar technology leader in a growth-stage SaaS company.
·      Experience with marketplace, community, payments, contract management, or compliance-sensitive platforms.
·      Familiarity with sports, college athletics, NIL, fintech, or adjacent industries.
·      Experience applying AI and automation to product or operational workflows.

The Environment You Will Be Joining

TheLinkU operates with a lean leadership structure and a small, capable offshore engineering team rather than multiple layers of engineering management, a dedicated DevOps organization, or a PMO. This gives the CTO genuine ownership of technical decisions, direct access to company leadership, and the opportunity to shape how the engineering organization evolves as the platform and customer base grow.

Why Join TheLinkU

·      Real ownership: you will be the technical decision-maker and a key member of the leadership team.
·      A live and growing product: LinkSuite is already supporting real university partners, athletes, contracts, and payments.
·      A meaningful market: NIL is changing how college athletes build their careers and financial futures.
·      A fast-moving leadership team where decisions are made quickly and leaders are trusted to execute.
We are setting the standard for the industry, come be a part of something special!!!

new_jobs.title: Director, Security Technology Operations
new_jobs.description:
When you believe that what you do matters, it's more than just a job. In the Office of Security, we are dedicated to protecting our people, clients, and facilities and we consider that mission central to our work. We are seeking an experienced Director, Security Technology Operations to lead Deloitte's enterprise security technology strategy, governance, and service delivery across the United States, India, and other affiliated geographies.

This role will oversee a complex, enterprise-wide security technology environment supporting approximately 250,000 U.S. employees, contractors, and building personnel, as well as approximately 135,000 employees and contractors in other geographies. The portfolio includes more than 10,000 security readers and cameras, support for approximately 480+ real estate construction projects annually, and a broad range of physical security, access, video, application, monitoring, reporting, and incident-response capabilities.

Recruiting for this role ends on October 5, 2026

Work you'll do

As a Director, Security Technology Operations on the Office of Security team, you will be responsible for:

Defining and leading the strategy, operating model, governance, and roadmap for Deloitte's security technology portfolio
Overseeing access control, video surveillance, badging, mobile badging, sensors, monitoring, reporting, and related services across the United States, India, and affiliated geographies
Directing security technology support for construction projects, office openings, and real estate coordination, including base-building integration and local office service delivery
Governing security applications, platforms, reporting, and service tools, including escalation support for outages, access issues, and operational continuity
Leading collaboration with Security, Real Estate, Information Technology, Procurement, Vendor Management, and other stakeholders to support investigations, mergers and acquisitions, crisis response, and innovation initiatives

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

The Office of Security helps protect Deloitte's people, facilities, operations, and brand by enabling safe, secure, and resilient business environments. The team partners across Security, Real Estate, Information Technology, and business stakeholders to deliver physical security strategy, programs, and technology services at enterprise scale. This role is part of a collaborative environment focused on operational excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement across a complex footprint.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree and 15+ years of progressive experience in security technology, physical security, corporate security, or enterprise technology
Experience leading an enterprise security technology portfolio across multiple offices, regions, or stakeholder groups
Experience with access control, badging, video surveillance, security monitoring, and security technology platforms
Experience managing budgets, vendors, service providers, and enterprise real estate physical security standards for base buildings and interior spaces
Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearance and meet the applicable U.S.-national requirement for GPS federal security design and technical support responsibilities
Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Experience supporting a geographically dispersed organization
Experience supporting federal or government security requirements
Experience with enterprise badging, mobile badging, sensors, and security operations platforms
Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, insider threat, investigations, or crisis response
Experience supporting international locations and cross-border operations
Experience with CCure, Safetrust, GSOC applications, and Exacq closed-circuit television/internet protocol video platforms

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. new_jobs.description:
About Us

Schring Consulting is a trusted provider of IT Professional Services, helping organizations plan, build, and deliver technology initiatives that drive business success. Founded in 2003, Schring specializes in software development, project delivery, IT consulting, and staff augmentation. We partner with clients across multiple industries, providing high-quality technical talent and innovative solutions to solve complex business challenges.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Director of Systems Engineering to join our client's technology leadership team. This is a contract-to-hire
role that leads to a full-time, onsite leadership opportunity based in Worcester, Massachusetts.

The ideal candidate is an experienced infrastructure leader with deep expertise in enterprise systems, cloud platforms, virtualization, storage, DevOps, and IT operations
. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical oversight, ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of the university's critical infrastructure while leading a team of engineers and collaborating across multiple departments.

You will play a key role in driving infrastructure modernization, improving operational efficiency through automation, supporting enterprise applications, and overseeing technologies that support both academic operations and campus safety.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop the Systems Engineering team while providing strategic direction and technical guidance.
Oversee enterprise server infrastructure, storage platforms, virtualization, and cloud environments
(AWS and Azure).
Manage day-to-day systems operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and reliability.
Drive infrastructure automation and DevOps initiatives to improve operational efficiency.
Lead the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of enterprise infrastructure solutions.
Support enterprise applications through management of databases, middleware, web services, and load balancing.
Oversee campus safety technologies, including physical access control, video surveillance, emergency communications, and related systems.
Ensure infrastructure security, compliance, vulnerability remediation, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Manage infrastructure budgets, vendor relationships, licensing, and technology lifecycle planning.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point during major infrastructure incidents.
Collaborate with IT leadership, academic departments, campus stakeholders, and external vendors to deliver reliable technology solutions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
Minimum of 7 years of experience in Systems Engineering, Infrastructure, or IT Operations.
Previous experience leading infrastructure, systems, or operations teams.
Strong expertise with:
Windows Server and Linux administration
Enterprise storage platforms
Virtualization technologies
AWS and Azure cloud platforms
Enterprise backup and disaster recovery
DevOps and infrastructure automation
Database platforms, middleware, web services, and load balancing
Strong understanding of enterprise security, compliance, business continuity, and disaster recovery best practices.
Experience managing infrastructure budgets and vendor relationships.
Excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Microsoft Windows Server certifications.
Microsoft Azure or AWS certifications.
Red Hat certifications (RHCSA or RHCE).
Nutanix certifications.
NetApp certifications.
Rubrik certifications.
Experience with enterprise monitoring, patch management, and IT service management platforms.
Experience supporting higher education or large enterprise environments.
